notes.title: 20220309 Update!
notes.content:
Dear players!
I have been hard working on game and I have reacted several tips from you

* New mission - Harbor!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37791325/7f6805c262268e5f65012eb5bc4253698d532acc.png[/img]

* You can play  in Top down mode now for better clarity in combat!
Use C key or Middle mouse button to change camera
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37791325/a01c1c3a6587dc789cef61c6ea95922de209e20e.png[/img]

* New better and more intuitive controls
* Graphics changes for top down view
* Post process update
* Lightmap reworked in all missions
* Mission 10 - Bomb explode after 15 turns
* 3D view camera can be rotated every 45 degrees
* New control scheme:

SWAD - move camera
QE - rotate camera
C - change camera view
Left mouse button - actions with units, action selection
Right mouse button - change unit view
Middle mouse button - change camera 3D View/Top Down

Top down view: 
Mouse wheel: camera zoom
3D view: 
Mouse wheel: camera rotation +- 45 degrees

notes.content:

notes.title: 20211019 Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37791325/6900d5d932bc09d03011c4eca57f476d91511721.jpg[/img]

Dear players!
I have been hard working on game and I have reacted several tips from you

* Welcome achievement bug fixed
* Changes in game interface. You can click on suspects and select weapon fire actions directly
* Units have more actions points - new default value is 10. You can do more actions during turn.
If you have skill points more than 40 - action points will increase to 11
If you have skill points more than 70 - action points will increase to 12
* Using explosives on doors have impact to suspects if stand close to the doors -
morale will be decreased, depend on how are distance between suspects and doors
* Fixed bug with map borders
* Better loading time of menu

notes.title: The Flare Path: Demo Charge
notes.content: I wanted to burn the following appetisers onto a CD then sellotape the disc to the front cover of today’s column but Graham said that was “technically impossible” so links and enticing descriptions will have to suffice. Be aware that most of the demos detailed below will self-destruct when the ongoing Steam Game Festival ends next Tuesday, and that the line-up is the result of careful curation not haphazard Googling. Not all of the trials I played this week passed my fussy quality control criteria. (more…)

notes.title: Tactical Combat Department demo available!
notes.content:
Dear players,
Game festival demo is here!
In the game there are 2 demo missions. 
Demo has several limits as disabled save and equipment selection

About the Game:
Tactical Combat Department is a tactical turn-based strategy game. You command a special intervention squad that intervenes in various situations and environments.

Base tactical hints:
Before entering the room, it is recommended to use a camera to check the number and location of suspects. The door can be opened in many ways, such as slowly opening the door, kicking it out or using explosives, etc. Some doors may be locked. Then it is necessary to use a unique multifunction tool to open it.
It is a good idea to be safe using a Flashbang grenade before entering. It is advisable to continually guard access to the room and cover the space and corners as well. It is also advisable not to shatter the team too much and rely on yourself more.
It is ideal for moving forward considering the protection of the lives of civilians, armed suspects and, of course, members of your team.
Choose from an intense dynamic action such as blasting the door or kicking them in. In this case, however, you can face opponents from the outside but also the inside. In many situations, therefore, a quiet action is more appropriate, like a slow opening of the door using a handle etc.
